protocol.decision_scope: Final bounded investment decision for MDL-driven dense correspondence on the current AST proxy setting; not a theorem about every MDL method. Failure closes this branch and does not launch MLP.
protocol.alignment: One joint rigid GPA of 140 cached extracted meshes, proper rotations and translations only; fixed during the local diagnostic. No scale normalization.
protocol.chart: Common grand-mean harmonic chart, previous neutral patch centers, six coefficients per shape; same chart and compact-support basis for all states. Original mesh boundary one-rings and patch exterior fixed. Original piecewise planar surfaces; not a complete TPS/L-BFGS reproduction.
protocol.joint_objective: Subtract one grand mean shape across identities and expressions. G_id=A_(id) A_(id)^T / 7; G_expr=A_(expr) A_(expr)^T / 20. All 20 and 7 eigenvalues, including zeros. Each mode reference is its baseline trace divided by dimension, frozen. Objective is mean log spectrum for identity plus mean log spectrum for expression. Report actual ranks; never inherit single-state K=19.
protocol.single_objective: Mean of seven existing within-state E_COMP/19, same full spectrum and fixed reference.
protocol.regularizer: Paper-inspired mean squared double umbrella U^2 on sampled mesh vertex positions. Local changes include all affected two-ring rows. Same regularizer in all arms; no shrinkage of coefficients toward truth and no dense correspondence objective.
protocol.starts: Geometry-valid synthetic independent-state or identity-shared chart corruption. Exact sparse LS nearest the corrupted input, two layouts. No repairs of invalid sparse starts; report all. Add exact uncorrupted controls once per seed/layout, never repeat them per pattern. 24 corrupted cohorts plus 6 controls.
protocol.directions: At sparse optimum, no-noise directions projected into exact fitting-anchor nullspace; noisy directions use full space. Normalize projected regularizer and energy gradients separately, energy ratios fixed to 0.1 and 1 before results. Each Armijo objective freezes these weights during line search.
protocol.constraints: Each shape fitting-anchor MSE increase at most 2*sigma_q^2+1e-12; no normal reversals, area ratio >=0.2, displacement <=1% diagonal. 12 Armijo halvings. No dense truth in steps or selection.
protocol.observations: Same synthetic observations shared across arms. Disjoint fitting, 12 selection and 12 audit vertices. Dense evaluation excludes their union. Selection gain is averaged across 7 states within each identity before a fixed >max(1e-12,2*SE) heuristic. Not a formal significance test.
protocol.structure_controls: Common identity permutation must preserve both scores; independent identity permutations per expression must preserve single scores. Joint-score response to broken pairing is descriptive only. Check finite differences and reduced/full Gram equality before outcome interpretation.
protocol.conditional_closed_loop: Run only if all local gates pass: reuse frozen inputs and weights, at most 80 accepted constrained steps, stop on relative projected-gradient <=1e-5; report line-search failure or cap as not converged. Same 3 scientific arms with ratios selected only by sparse selection observations. Network entry additionally requires >=80% convergence and repeatable >1% added final recovery with geometry and variance guards. If local gate fails, do not run or retune closed loop.
protocol.not_in_scope: No neural training, new identities, archive reads, broad hyperparameter search, automatic pivot to model compression or additional v6. Heldout reconstruction is not a rescue criterion for correspondence.
protocol.limitations: All identities previously viewed; AST correspondence proxy and synthetic observations; baseline-derived common chart and fixed rigid alignment; local six-parameter field and finite candidate pool. Failure is a final project-budget stop, not universal MDL impossibility.
